expectations.prior_reference: docs/probe/07_v04_prefreeze_checks.md §3; docs/probe/09_rpi5_prefreeze_checks.md (format only, no numeric cross-kernel comparison)

cases.fork: Parent/child same ELF, samples in both PIDs. Child may lack own MMAP2. dsoff/PT_LOAD valid; verified identity when sampled mmap2 ID present.
cases.exec: Same PID switches cases to after; target-specific conversions separate both images, sample dsoff in corresponding PT_LOAD; no forced reuse of old mapping.
cases.deleted: Test copy deleted after load; original complete path contains (deleted). If no mmap2/buildid-list evidence, default unverified rejection; explicit allow-missing permits conversion; never invent verified.
cases.module: Loaded module .ko samples are kernel classification, not user ELF target. System workload cases is target; modules stay excluded; no module installation.
cases.system: Preserve full -a export. Record -1/-1 samples if observed, pid_unknown counts and --pid not matching unknown; absence reported, not constructed.
cases.lost: Independent count of full export LOST records, N sum L and all sample lines S; compare quality report ratio L/(L+S). At least 100 records and L>=1000 for substantial LOST; use short pilot to size full RUN.

expectations.deleted_window_note: Use 0.1s perf attach workload, as previously measured in probe07; target finishes afterwards with child exit checked. 3s can overrun target and produce perf143.
